_description: The FITTED deep-time input of the ESSRT rotation history — the banked record (plan 11 step 1) of the one deep-time measurement that remains a fit: the GIA channel's relaxation time τ. Every runtime reads it through the generated constants module (tools/constants/generate.mjs assembles DEFAULT_CONSTANTS.deepTime from this file, astro-reference.json and data/deltaT-4flag-fit.json). Plan 12 (option A) removed the other two families from this file: the quartic's α₃/α₄ (a two-coefficient least-squares copy of Farhat 2022's curve) and the Driver-1½ regime block (knots fitted to the rock record, plus the solar-channel budget) — the Earth–Moon distance history is a CITED PHYSICAL INPUT now, data/astrogeo22-earth-moon.json (Farhat, Auclair-Desrotour, Boué & Laskar 2022), read by packages/physics/src/deltat/moon-distance-history.cjs; git history and holisticuniverse docs/plans/12 carry the deleted blocks and their reproduction record. Not a parameter anyone types: a re-measurement is a CAMPAIGN under the paleo-anchors gate (tools/verify/paleo-anchors.js, where an unexplained improvement fails too).

meta.generator: none — a banked fitted record (plan 11 step 1); the fitter that produced the value is named below
meta.plan: holisticuniverse docs/plans/11 IP-retire-model-parameters-input.md §8.2; docs/plans/12 (option A) for the two families that left

_alphaGiaRelaxationNote: τ of the GIA channel — the LAGGED response of Earth's polar moment to the ice history the climate formula's L1 proxies (@essrt/physics climate/l1-orbital createAlphaGiaChannel). MEASURED against the historical ΔT record through the joint ΔT fitter (plan 06 D7, 2026-09-20): optimum 5–6 kyr, the degree-2 Maxwell estimate; the coupling k is DERIVED at runtime from the Cox & Chao rate (astro-reference giaCoxChaoPeltier), so no scale is stored. The τ scan was a plan-06 instrument, since deleted; the eclipse-audit and lunar-alignment campaigns record what the shipped τ does.
